turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste ji, main aapki madad ke liye call kiya hai, kaise help karun?

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Ji mera settlement ke liye TavSathi check karna tha, aur cheque Power bhi activate karwana hai.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Thik hai, hum KhedUdhaar pe discount laga ke dekhte hain, wallet Swift se bhi transfer kar sakte hain.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Aur KhedSetu se verification bhi chahiye tha, lekin PhonePe Select se toh paisa aa gaya lagta hai.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Ji Niyo Super pe approval mil chuka hai, bas Aadhaar Secure verify karke settlement complete kar dunga.
